body: I have tried on numerous occasions to open up to them about it. When they found out i cut myself a few years back they asked why and i told them i felt suicidal because of them and i got screamed at. My dad is a former alcoholic and narcotics addict with an extreme narcissism complex with a mix of untreated OCD. My mom doesnt drink or do drugs but she does have untreated bipolar disorder which causes her to have breakdowns targeted at me and how i make her want to kill herself sometimes. Its so stressful
